'''pointy-eared green dude Alrighty! ANOTHER Classic Quiet Mining Colony...''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[pointy-eared green dude]]
* '''Published:''' 3 February 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Quiet Mining Colony|ECC-L-quietminingcolony.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Quiet Mining Colony
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 QMC dude LS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Okay, I think this deck of mine really KICKS.  I've taken small bits of ideas and details and put them all together into this.  Some of the ideas are my own...but some are you guys.  Whatcha think?

== Strategy ==

Okay, I really use Order To Engage alot (see my strategy article?)...so yeah.  I also have some heavy draining possibilities if I feel like going though with it (lightsabers, Launching The Assault, flipside of QMC).  However, I love to pull of Keeping The Empire Out Forever, that way I dictate EXACTLY what I want, when I want.  My Mains come armed an dangerous, and can put up a good fight if it comes down to it.  Same in space ("Uh, captain...there's a big @$$ aesthetic ship on our scopes, what should we do?)...  :D  I love this deck.  Thanks you guys for the hints and strategies you gave me...I hope this deck is what you were thinking.

NOTE:  I do need a third starting effect, and I don't have Wokling.  What could go in its place???
